description: Search Google and get parsed results as JSON: organic_results (position, title, link, domain, displayed_link, snippet, date), related_searches, search_information (including spelling corrections) and pagination. 10 results per page; position restarts at 1 on every page. Priced per search (see https://webscraping.ai/docs#serp); failed searches are not charged. Use it to find pages, then read them with webscraping_ai_text or the other tools.

engine.description: Search engine to query (google by default).

gl.description: Two-letter country code for the search, e.g. us, gb, de (us by default).

hl.description: Two-letter language code for the results, e.g. en, de, fr (en by default).

page.description: Results page number, 10 results per page (1 by default).

name: webscraping_ai_serp
title: Search Google
